title: Main Customer Purchase Journey

cart.label: Add medicine to cart; manage cart

check.label: Check session, cart, stock and prescription

address.label: Select saved / add new delivery address

place.label: Review summary / optional reward; place order

create.label: Create order, items and order ID

hold.label: Cancel / hold order under system rules

process.label:
Process next stage:

destroy.label: Destroy session; redirect to home / login

form.label: Enter name, email, phone, address and password

title: Medicine Browsing & Prescription Requirement

search.label: Search; filter category / price; select details

note: Checkout still requires prescription approval for medicines that require a prescription.

addcart.label: Add medicine to cart; display Cart Updated

notcart.label: Explain item must be in cart

saved.label: Move cart item to Saved for Later; confirm

schedule.label: Choose frequency, quantity and start date

edit.label: Increase / decrease quantity; remove; save for later; move saved item to cart

checks.label: Check authentication, nonempty cart, stock and required prescription approval

error.label: Show error: empty cart, stock, pending / rejected prescription, or unavailable item

noarea.label: Display Delivery not available in this area

none.label: Display Reward unavailable; continue without reward

summary.label: Review medicines, quantity, address, total and reward discount

hold.label: Cancel / hold order under system rules

completion.label: Begin successful-payment completion: payment record, confirmation and inventory work

title: Parallel Post-Payment Completion

stock.label: Update medicine stock; record stock movement

note: All five fork branches must finish before the join continues. Notification preferences are resolved by the notification workflow.

dashboard.label: Open Staff Dashboard; view pending orders

wait.label: Wait for readiness; recheck pending order

process.label: Process next stage: Confirmed → Packed → Out for Delivery → Delivered

update.label: Update order for the new status

status.label: Display current status: Pending / Confirmed / Packed / Out for Delivery / Delivered / Cancelled

title: Order Cancellation & Refund Handling

refund.label: Initiate / mark refund under system rules

note: Eligibility: not delivered, not already cancelled and within the permitted processing stage. Refund execution follows the system payment rules.

title: Notification Preferences & Delivery

event.label: Receive event: OTP; prescription decision; payment success / failure; order status / cancellation; subscription reminder

prefs.label: Check notification preferences and event requirements

prepare.label: Prepare message for enabled / required channel

send.label: Send OTP / notification through configured channel

note: Optional-message preferences do not suppress OTP needed for authentication. Other configured channels follow the same system notification decision.

thanks.label: Display Thank you for your feedback

active.label: Keep active; proceed to next cycle

reports.label: Choose orders, payments, customers, prescriptions, stock movements, reviews, referral rewards or dashboard statistics

destroy.label: Destroy session; record activity if applicable
